Claude Code appears only where the company describes its staff's tools, so it is nice_to_have under rule 4's opening-paragraph clause. It is flagged uncertain.
'LLM safety patterns' names LLM, so llms is labeled nice_to_have.
I left 'enterprise tool ecosystem integration' unmapped. It is only loosely related to tool-calling or apis.
